Callout.Name: ATM Damage
Callout.Message: Cash machine attacked with tools overnight.
Callout.Advisory: No suspects on scene, damage extensive.

Script.Line: It was like that when I walked past.
I am waiting for a taxi. That is why I am stood here.
Check my hands. Go on, there is no dye on my hands.

Lines.Approach: They went at it with something heavy and got nowhere. Forensics will want a look.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
